purpose: DRAISegmentation is a 3D Slicer extension that provides AI-powered segmentation and 3D surface modeling for Spine/Pelvis CT and Aorta-Iliac-Femoral CTA by uploading volumes to the Deep Reasoning AI cloud server.
summary: DRAISegmentation is a well-structured Slicer extension providing cloud-based AI segmentation for medical imaging. It features explicit user consent prior to data transmission, robust error handling, proper CMake packaging, and a clear BSD 3-Clause license. 🟢 Recommend merge

safety.rationale: Explicit informed consent dialog is shown before uploading patient data to the cloud service; secure API usage with standard libraries and requests fallback.

environment.rationale: No changes to shared environment or package pins; standard ScriptedLoadableModule structure.

packaging.rationale: CMakeLists.txt and module structure correctly build and package the Python script and resources.

license.rationale: Clear BSD 3-Clause license provided in the repository.

soundness.rationale: Robust error handling, polling, asynchronous UI updates, and clean ScriptedLoadableModule design.

utility.rationale: Clear documentation, usage instructions, supported models, and disclaimer provided in README and module text.

not_checked: External repository commit execution (not runnable without Slicer/network)
